title: Assassin's Creed
setupHint: Play until Assassin's Creed saves, or select the save in Settings.
pathPlaceholder: Path to %APPDATA%\Ubisoft\Assassin's Creed\Saved Games (or the .sav file in it)
trackingNote: Assassin's Creed keeps its own record of every achievement in its save (%APPDATA%\Ubisoft\Assassin's Creed\Saved Games). The plugin reads it, so all 44 unlock by themselves a few seconds after the game saves following the moment the game awards them. The story objectives and the save's own lists back it up: Welcome to the Animus, Hero of Masyaf, The Punishment for Treason, all nine Blood achievements, Personal Vendetta (60 Templars), every flag Keeper and Fearless (91 viewpoints) also unlock from them, each shown as progress, and Eagle's Prey, Swiftness, Talon, Dance and March of the Pious show the game's running counts. Record an achievement and Capture while I play still watch the same folder.
autoTag: Unlocks automatically from your Assassin's Creed save
